alleged_issues.issue: Discrepancy in GSTR-1 vs GSTR-3B tax payment for October 2023
alleged_issues.evidence_quote: Tax reported in GSTR-1 exceeds tax discharged through cash and credit in GSTR-3B by Rs 85,000

analysis.summary_en: You have received an ASMT-10 scrutiny letter regarding tax paid for October 2023. The officer alleges that outward tax declared in GSTR-1 was higher than the amount paid in GSTR-3B by Rs. 85,000. Please note that several extracted fields from this scan have low confidence due to blurry text. You should carefully verify the notice date and demanded amount against your physical paper copy before submitting. Under Rule 99, this notice requires an explanation in Form GST ASMT-11 within 30 days. Demonstrating that the tax was paid in subsequent returns or through Form DRC-03 will satisfy the query.
analysis.summary_hi: आपको अक्टूबर 2023 के कर भुगतान के संबंध में फॉर्म ASMT-10 में जांच सूचना प्राप्त हुई है। अधिकारी का कहना है कि GSTR-1 में घोषित कर, GSTR-3B में चुकाए गए कर से ₹85,000 अधिक था। कृपया ध्यान दें कि धुंधले स्कैन के कारण नोटिस की तारीख और राशि जैसे कुछ विवरणों पर कम सटीकता दर्ज की गई है; कृपया अपने मूल दस्तावेज से इनकी पुष्टि अवश्य करें। नियम 99 के तहत, इसका जवाब 30 दिनों में फॉर्म GST ASMT-11 में दिया जाना चाहिए। यदि यह कर अगले महीने या DRC-03 के माध्यम से भर दिया गया है, तो उसकी रसीद संलग्न करें।

draft.body_md:
# REPLY TO SCRUTINY INTIMATION (FORM GST ASMT-11)

**To:**
The Proper Officer / Assistant Commissioner,
Ward 63, Department of Trade & Taxes,
New Delhi

**Subject:** Reply to Form GST ASMT-10 Notice Ref: F.NO.GST/DL/W63/2026/1089 dated 05-10-2026

**GSTIN:** 07AABCS1429B1Z2  
**Taxpayer Name:** Modern Hardware Stores  
**Tax Period:** October 2023  

---

Respected Sir,

### 1. Verification of Notice Particulars
With reference to notice in Form GST ASMT-10 issued under Section 61 [[cgst-act-s61#p1]] read with Rule 99 [[cgst-rules-r99#p1]], we hereby submit our explanation within the 30-day timeline.

### 2. Explanation Regarding Difference in GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B
1. It is submitted that the alleged discrepancy of Rs. 85,000/- was due to an inadvertent clerical entry during the preparation of GSTR-1 [ADD: Specific invoice number and date mistakenly reported twice].
2. The actual taxable supplies and corresponding tax liability were correctly computed and discharged in full [ADD: Exact tax amount paid and challan CIN number].
3. Furthermore, any residual differential tax along with applicable interest was paid voluntarily [ADD: Form GST DRC-03 ARN and date of payment].
4. There is no loss caused to the revenue, and the tax stands fully realized by the Government exchequer.

### 3. Prayer
In view of the above clarification and compliance under Rule 99 [[cgst-rules-r99#p1]], we request your good office to:
a) Accept the explanation and issue an order of acceptance in Form GST ASMT-12;
b) Drop further proceedings in the matter.

---

### 4. Enclosures
1. Form GST DRC-03 payment receipt.
2. Inward and outward sales reconciliation register.
3. Copy of monthly bank statement.
4. [ADD: Affidavit / CA Certificate explaining the clerical error].

Yours faithfully,

For **Modern Hardware Stores**



__________________________________  
**Proprietor / Authorized Signatory**  
Date: [Date of Reply Submission]

cgst-act-s61#p1.content: The proper officer may scrutinize the return and related particulars furnished by the registered person to verify the correctness of the return and inform him of the discrepancies noticed, if any, in such manner as may be prescribed and seek his explanation thereto.

cgst-rules-r99#p1.content: Where any return furnished by a registered person is selected for scrutiny, the proper officer shall scrutinize the same with reference to the information available with him, and in case of any discrepancy, he shall issue a notice to the said person in FORM GST ASMT-10, informing him of such discrepancy and seeking his explanation thereto within such time, not exceeding thirty days from the date of service of the notice.
